text: Which of the following is an example of Operating System software?
explanation: Ubuntu Linux is an operating system — it manages hardware resources and provides a platform for other software to run. Word and VLC are application software; CCleaner is utility software.

text: What is the primary purpose of application software?

options.text: To manage hardware resources on behalf of other programs
To perform user tasks like word processing, browsing, or editing
To maintain and optimise the system
To provide an interface between hardware and device drivers

explanation: Application software is designed to help the user carry out specific tasks — word processing, web browsing, video editing, gaming, etc. It runs on top of the OS and uses OS services to interact with hardware.

text: Which two of the following are examples of utility software? (Choose two)
explanation: Utility software performs system maintenance tasks. Antivirus software protects the system from malware, and disk cleanup tools remove unnecessary files to free up space. Web browsers and spreadsheet apps are application software used for user tasks.

text: What does a file extension tell the operating system?

options.text: The size of the file in bytes
The date the file was created
The type of file and which application should open it
Whether the file has been backed up

explanation: A file extension (the suffix after the dot, e.g. .txt, .exe, .jpg) tells the OS what type of file it is and which application to use to open it. For example, .exe tells the OS it is an executable program; .docx tells it to open with Word.

text: Match each software type to its correct example.

columnB.text: Windows 11 — manages hardware and provides a platform for programs
Google Chrome — lets the user browse the web
Disk Defragmenter — optimises file storage on the hard drive

explanation: OS software manages the system (Windows, Linux, macOS). Application software helps users complete tasks (browsers, word processors, games). Utility software maintains and optimises the system (antivirus, disk tools, backup software).

text: A technician installs software that scans for malware, removes temporary files, and defragments the hard drive. What type of software is this?
explanation: Software that performs system maintenance — scanning for malware, cleaning files, defragmenting storage — is utility software. Its purpose is to keep the system running efficiently rather than to help the user complete a work task.

text: Which file extension indicates an executable program on Windows?
explanation: The .exe extension (short for executable) tells Windows that the file is a program that can be run. The OS uses this extension to identify the file type and handle it appropriately. Double-clicking an .exe launches the program.
